knowledge.title: Knowledge
knowledge.description: Product facts, pricing and policies the AI grounds its drafts in. Documents marked Always included go into every draft.

editor.description: Every saved edit creates a new version.
editor.contentHint: Markdown. Headings and lists help the AI find the right part.

instructions.title: Instructions
instructions.description: Guidance added to every AI draft and classification. Each instruction is sent to the AI as its own titled section.

noPipeline.title: No CRM pipeline yet
noPipeline.body: Instructions belong to the default CRM pipeline, and none is configured yet.

draftInstructions.title: Reply drafting
draftInstructions.helper: Added to every draft the AI writes — email, LinkedIn and WhatsApp.
draftInstructions.placeholder: Sign off as Priya from Youse. Keep emails under 120 words. Never offer discounts; suggest a 20-minute call instead.
draftInstructions.emptyText: No instructions yet — add one to shape every draft.

classificationInstructions.title: Reply classification
classificationInstructions.helper: Added to every classification of a reply or call.
classificationInstructions.placeholder: A referral to a colleague counts as Interested, not Other. Replies from agencies are Not interested.
classificationInstructions.emptyText: No instructions yet — add one to shape every classification.

callingInstructions.title: Calling
callingInstructions.helper: How the AI agent runs every WhatsApp call: the opening, the shape of the call, how it talks. Use '{{'agentName'}}' and '{{'firstName'}}'. Who it is, being honest that it is an AI, each campaign's goal and how a call ends stay fixed. Try changes with a rehearsal call on a campaign's sequence.
callingInstructions.placeholder: Never mention competitors by name. If they say they already use an agency, ask what the agency does for their landing pages.
callingInstructions.emptyText: No calling instructions — saving an empty list brings back the defaults.

section.defaultsNotice: These are the built-in instructions. Edit them and save to make them yours; Reset to defaults brings them back.
